summary.text: Eric Helvy is the Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Rashaun Kemp.
An educator, he won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary over Gregory Thomas.

paragraphs.text: Eric Helvy earned a high school diploma from Paul Harding High School, a bachelor's degree from Virginia Union University in 1996, a graduate degree from Chicago State University in 2003 and a graduate degree from Walden University in 2009, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an educator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, the campaign described him as a father, husband, educator, public safety advocate and community leader based in Atlanta with more than two decades of experience in education, criminal justice and community development.
The survey lists public safety, tax relief and economic development, and school choice as his main policy priorities.
